concept: EBS gp3: IOPS and throughput independent of volume size
tests: Choosing an EBS type for a database with specified IOPS and throughput at minimal cost.
expected: gp3 with separately provisioned IOPS (up to 16,000) and throughput (up to 1,000 MB/s) independent of size — pay only for the performance you need. Triggers: "16,000 IOPS", "500 MB/s", "self-managed database", "cost as low as possible".
why_not: st1 and sc1 are HDD for sequential reads, not random DB IOPS (sc1 is for cold data); io2 also works but costs more for such a moderate load.
